```mermaid
graph LR
  content[content: src/content.ts + src/data/*.json] --> engine[engine: src/engine.ts, expression.ts, types.ts]
  persistence[persistence: src/persistence.ts] --> engine
```

There are no cycles. `src/engine.ts` imports only `./expression` and `./types`. Content is plain JSON concatenated in a fixed order by `src/content.ts:7-8`. [HIGH]
